verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud documents OpenMetrics export to Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog/New Relic/etc. (temporal-docs-27), and the CLI/docs provide Task Queue querying and worker tuning guidance (temporal-docs-29) plus a Web UI for execution-state debugging (temporal-docs-8), all of which support building failure-rate/latency/queue-depth dashboards and alerts in an external observability stack. However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates the exported metric types (failure rate, latency, queue depth) nor documents any built-in alerting mechanism—alerting would rely entirely on the downstream tool once metrics are streamed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of specific exported metrics (error/failure rate, latency percentiles, queue depth) and any native or integrated alerting configuration guidance.
